newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Smith Barney starts Donnelly.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Smith Barney starts Donnelly.

text.p: -- Smith Barney confirmed Tuesday that it had initiated coverage of Donnelly Corp with a buy rating.
-- Smith Barney analyst David Garrity said in a report that he had set a 12- to 18-month target price of $34 a share on Donnelly.
-- Smith Barney said Donnelly is ready to expand margins and accelerate earnings per share growth now that it has successfully resolved patent litigation.
-- Donnelly has completed most of the major capacity spending needed to support its goal of 15 percent annual sales growth over the next five years, Smith Barney said.
-- Smith Barney sees Donnelly benefiting from lower interest expense.
